card.name: Decimal point inside numbers
card.fires_on: The period used as a decimal point right after a single leading digit, such as 1, 2 or 9, before the decimal digits. It appears in lab values, doses, table numbers and version names like 2.0.

modes.label: Lab and dose values
modes.description: Decimal point after a digit in thresholds, doses or ranges.

modes.label: Tables and version numbers
modes.description: Decimal point in table figures or a version name such as 2.0.

card.writes: It suppresses decimal-point and period tokens and promotes the word float, so it pushes against more decimal-point tokens right after a digit.
card.plain: It marks the decimal point inside a number like 1.5 or 2.0, right after the first digit.
